content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Chittoor Recruitment 2026 Offline

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Chittoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Chittoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Driver (On Hire basis).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA Chittoor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application format enclosed with the notification (pages 5-6), with a call letter (page 7)) and send it to Chairperson-cum-Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, District Court Buildings Complex, Chittoor, by registered post / speed post only, to reach by 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 44 years (as on 1 September 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/BC/EWS 5 years, Ex-Servicemen 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 800 per working day, subject to a maximum ceiling of Rs. 23,780 a month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10th Class and a Heavy Motor Vehicle (HMV) driving license.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be of sound health, active habits and free from any bodily defect or infirmity rendering him/her unfit for the service. Character and antecedents must not disqualify for the service. Applicant must indicate Local/Non Local status in respect of Judicial Districts.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons dismissed from State or Central Government service or from a Central or State Government undertaking. Persons convicted by a Court of Law for an offence involving moral turpitude.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview (Viva Voce). Driving test. Original certificates to be produced for verification on the day informed by DLSA Chittoor.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on hire basis, purely temporary in nature, and will not confer any right for future employment.
